)
AND ( source_type != 'BOKJIRO_LOCAL' OR region_sido IS NULL OR region_sido = #{regionSido} )

ORDER BY CASE WHEN source_type = 'BOKJIRO_LOCAL' AND region_sido = #{regionSido} AND region_sigungu = #{regionSigungu} THEN 1 WHEN source_type = 'BOKJIRO_LOCAL' AND region_sido = #{regionSido} THEN 2 WHEN source_type = 'BOKJIRO_NATIONAL' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END, welfare_support_product_id DESC
